property_summary: After the owner calls transferOwnership(newOwner) with any nonzero newOwner distinct from the current owner, the contract's owner() must become exactly newOwner; the buggy version instead keeps ownership at the caller, so owner() stays unchanged and violates the rule.
change_summary: Replace _transferOwnership(newOwner) with _transferOwnership(_msgSender()) so the owner is always set to the caller.
